dataset_name: ENGINE-TWIN generic aero piston-engine synthetic research dataset
known_limitations: No target engine identified or calibrated.
Generic surrogate equations are illustrative, not a validated thermodynamic engine model.
Synthetic fault signatures are designed by the generator and may be easier to classify than real faults.
Some parameter relationships are simplified and may be physically unrealistic outside this narrow research prototype.
Ambient pressure is an approximate standard-atmosphere baseline with temperature adjustment.
Sensor channels and units are provisional; verify against selected engine instrumentation.
